'''Policy''' is the RL name for the thing that decides what to do next. Here it is the language model plus its current [[lora|LoRA adapter]]. Given everything so far (the task, previous tool calls, page text), the policy produces the next tokens, which become the next action.

"Updating the policy" means changing the adapter's numbers. The base model never changes. During a run there are several versions of the policy: the one that generated the current attempts, the one being trained, and sometimes a frozen '''reference policy''' (the original model) for the [[kl-penalty]].
